title: Nuevas sociedades urbanas
goal: Read how urbanization produced a growing informal economy alongside formal jobs, persistent wage gaps for working women, and an early consumer culture that didn't erase old inequalities.
grammar: Por más que + subjuntivo: una desigualdad persistente

items: Explain where most newcomers to cities actually ended up working.
State what happened to women's wages despite growing labor participation.
Describe the new urban consumer culture that emerged.
Explain what these transformations failed to eliminate.
Use por más que + subjunctive to describe a stubborn, persistent limit.
